description: TasksBackend::task_list_has_tasks returns impl Future<Output = bool> while sibling traits CalendarsBackend::calendar_has_events and ContactsBackend::address_book_has_contents both return Result<bool, Self::Error>. The calendars analog was widened in bd:JMAP-ic0j.4 to handle the backend-failure case (handler maps Err(_) to serverFail rather than silently treating a backend error as 'no tasks exist'). A backend whose storage query fails will currently return false, causing the handler to proceed with destruction of a TaskList that may still contain tasks — a data-integrity bug in production backends with fallible storage. Fix: widen return type to Result<bool, Self::Error>, update handler in task_list.rs to map Err(_) to serverFail, update MemoryBackend impl accordingly. Analogous to JMAP-ic0j.4.
title: task_list_has_tasks returns bare bool unlike sibling traits
